'''2007 Worlds Team Lee Edwards DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Lee Edwards]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

Doug Taylor Needs to Resign. OCR heavy. D2 Lee still parked.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Lee Edwards]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Set Your Course For Alderaan]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
